content:
Semantic comparison against every original canonical AC; current target 471f02ee1222551063cf5515b8a74b9e08c8665988c44ee51b34d7af9024b8cd

AC-1
condition: On module start, load() starts with status all; app.js:23,67. Loading has separate rendering at 46–49.
action: The retained selectField owner renders labelled All/Active/Archived/Paused choices; onChange updates status and calls load at app.js:11–19.
outcome: app.js:32–35 accepts latest API rows; 56 displays response length and 61 delegates rows. app.test.mjs:44–79 checks each requested status plus matching count/text; http.test.mjs:32–35 checks real server results.
interfaces: No new endpoint. Existing api.js:2 sends GET /api/projects?status=encoded current status; app.js:32 uses that owner. HTTP test uses the unchanged server in a private child instance.
verification: Node app assertions compare real app-module requests/rendering through a minimal DOM stand-in; the actual HTTP client/server contract passed. Actual-app browser request/display comparison and responsive verification were not run because browser use is explicitly unavailable.

AC-2
condition: The real renderRows click handler sets selected at app.js:61–63 independently of visible.
action: Tests select Tide, switch to archived where Tide is absent, then return to active and finally paused; app.test.mjs:54–79.
outcome: app.js:44 always renders selected name. selected is not cleared by load. renderRows receives selected.id at 61; empty success branches separately at 57–59. Native assertions show retained Tide, restored aria-pressed, 0 projects and empty message.
interfaces: Existing #rows/#selection owners and renderRows are reused; index.html remains unchanged. No selection lookup from currently visible array.
verification: Native app-module assertions distinguish hidden selection, restored row marker, successful empty response, error and loading. Browser behavior, keyboard focus and actual layout remain unreviewed under the explicit no-browser condition.

AC-3
condition: status and selected are application-level state at app.js:21–25, separate from request results.
action: showProblem(rows, () => void load()) at app.js:53 reuses Retry; load calls projects(status). app.test.mjs:82–99 drives real helper Retry; 102–134 drives rapid changes with controllable promises.
outcome: app.js:28,33,37 guards both success and catch by latest request identity; only current result/error renders. Tests cover old success after latest success/error, old error during latest loading/after latest success, current-filter Retry, selected panel during failure/loading and recovered aria-pressed.
interfaces: Existing api.js request owner and ui.js showProblem remain unchanged; loading, success-empty and error have separate branches, with aria-busy and count status.
verification: Five native tests passed including real HTTP 503 recovery and app-module deferred request races. Actual browser failure/Retry and quick-filter interaction are not verified; the DOM stand-in is explicitly not browser evidence.

AC-4
condition: Admin permission source and eligible-target policy are absent; Q-001 is yes/deferred. No administrator identity is invented.
action: Archive action cannot be wired without the endpoint/method, permission and confirmation/failure policy. No mutation control or fake local success was added.
outcome: Actual archive outcome is unimplemented pending Q-001. Full scope remains required; deferred is not resolved or excluded.
interfaces: Only GET /api/projects is provided. No archive API/type/permission/confirmation contract exists in supplied files.
verification: No valid archive behavior assertion or browser scenario can be executed until Q-001 is resolved. Needs endpoint+method+schema, permission judgment, confirmation and failure policies.
note: Exact historical bytes, JSON-packed to preserve whitespace. Not rewritten/relabelled evidence.
